title: fix(app-shell): the Assigned users section shows a grant row read with no id without a Remove, and pins the one-holder and empty Add refusals
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu81D9AJpgGDC2B1HZ6bHfRJ)_

Fixes #32807

## 维护者速读

- 问题：#32800 之后权限集「已分配用户」区还剩 6 条 nit：Add 被拒时单候选、空候选两种情况没有 pin；选「本环境」候选后的重发被认为是死路；没有 id 的授权行被记成字符串 "undefined"；上个 PR 正文没点名套件、没写克隆/激活也读扁平 body。
- 改法：没有 id 的授权行（持有者行和「未归属」区）都不再显示移除按钮，不会发出 delete，也不会顶掉同一用户可移除的授权；为单候选、空候选、本环境按钮的重发各加 pin。
- 第 4 项在 `main` 上复核后删去：服务端只在请求指明了一个不持有的包时才列出「本环境」候选，此时按名重发会被接受（存成不带包的授权），不是死路。服务端探针实测过，pin 钉住重发的形状。
- 第 3、6 项是文档，写在下面。
- 单持有者（CONTROL）：请求与界面不变。只改 `@object-ui/app-shell` 一个组件，不动服务端，不放宽任何安全或权限判定，不加 i18n 键。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）审过。专题席复读 PASS-with-nits（6837420894），无必改项：没有 id 的授权行不再显示移除、不发删除；第 4 项删去的理由经复读在真引擎上验证成立。两个提交的 Claude-Session 尾注误写成席位会话，改写历史被拦截，作为偏差接受。复读的 nit 转跟进卡。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Items (re-read on `main` at `f770d664`)

| # | Item | Result | Pin (each ablated: revert the fix only → red; restore → blob equals HEAD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | No pin for a one-candidate refusal on Add | **pinned** (code was right) | `AssignedUsersSection.holderPick-32807.test.tsx` item 1: one button, exactly one `create` (the refused one) until it is clicked, then the clicked holder's package. Ablation "auto-pick on a one-element list" → red |
| 2 | No pin for `details.candidates: []` | **pinned** (code was right) | item 2: the server's sentence only, no pick, one `create`. Ablation "empty list accepted" in `candidatesIn` → red |
| 3 | #32800's body named no suites | **documentation**: the suites are named under Tests below | — |
| 4 | Environment pick on Add re-sends the refused request | **struck**: does not hold on `main` (reading below) | item 4 pins the re-send's shape: no `permission_set_package`, only the users still to grant. Ablation "environment pick falls back to the holding's package" → red |
| 5 | A grant row with no `id` keyed as `"undefined"` | **fixed**: `grantIdOf` reads the row's own id (a non-blank string or a finite number), else `null`. An id-less row has no Remove, in a holder's rows and in the unresolved block; as a direct grant it does not get the "held via a position" hint either; it never displaces the same user's removable grant | item 5 (two cases). Ablations: unresolved row `String(g.id)`; holder row `String(g.id)` last wins; unresolved Remove unguarded; id-less direct row shows the position hint → each red |
| 6 | `holderCandidatesOf` reads the flat body for clone and activation too | **documentation**: yes. Since #32800 the clone dialog and the activation switch read the refusal through `holderCandidatesOf`, which takes the wrapped envelope (`error.code`, `error.details.candidates`) and the flat body (`code`, `details.candidates`) alike. Those two doors answer the wrapped envelope today, so the flat arm is unused there and changes nothing they show | — |

CONTROL (one holder, no holding): `Add` sends `{ user_id, permission_set }` once per user, the grant read is `{ $filter: { permission_set }, $top: 500 }`, each direct grant is removed by its own id. It stays green under every ablation.

### Item 4: why it is struck

The Add pick offers the environment only when the refusal names it. On the grant door, a refusal names the environment only as `not-held-by-qualifier`: the grant named a package that does not hold the set, and the environment's own set exists (`judgeGrantSet` in plugin-security, from the catalog's per-holder list; the stamp seam the same way from the registry). A grant naming no package is resolved environment-wide, where the environment's own item answers first (`resolveEnvironmentWide` in core's `package-scoped-resolution.ts`). So the bare re-send is accepted. A bare grant is never refused naming the environment: with an environment item it resolves, and without one the environment is not a candidate.

Measured with a scratch probe on the real engine harness of `grant-permission-set-package.test.ts` (not committed; log and probe in the card thread's files): an environment-only set, and a set held by two packages plus the environment, each named with another package → `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the environment (and both packages); the bare re-send → stored, `permission_set_package` null.

## Files

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx`: `grantIdOf`; the holder rows' grant id map keeps a removable id; Remove only for a row with an id; the position hint only for a row with no direct grant.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.holderPick-32807.test.tsx`: new, 6 tests.
- `.changeset/32807-holder-pick-id-less-grant.md`: patch.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the committed head: 36 derived families, all exit 0 (includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`); `--ran`: 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Re-derived after merging `main` (`2fc3fce5`): the same 36.

## Acceptance notes

- No server change; no security or permission behaviour relaxed. Every change here withholds a Remove the row could not use. The server still judges every write.
- Branch is the card thread's `claude/project-thread-6szgqh` (the seat restated the claim with it).
- Deviation: the two commits' `Claude-Session:` trailer names the ui seat's session (`session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ`) instead of this card thread's (`session_01L6bhgUJgvMXh1RvYqfukAZ`); a history rewrite was not done. The squash commit message is the PR body, which names this one.
- An id-less grant row is something no first-party reader produces today (the grant reads ask for whole rows). The guard keeps the page honest if a host or a trimmed read hands one over.
